7ef680c2ab89: Open the Align tool · translationCore 4 Help
5e6b62c8398f: The checking tools use these links to highlight your words, and an aligned USFM export carries them.
e45cb668c003: Click Check, then Start checking → on the Align card.
d282158fcc1e: Pick a verse in the verse list on the left. Verses that are not drafted yet are greyed out.
e3b884563832: Link your words to the word cards. See Link your words to the source.
88485c019666: When the verse is done, click ✓ Mark valid. See Mark an alignment done.
9e63a70b7cb6: To leave, click ← All checking tools at the top left, or ← Back to translating at the bottom left.
ad5c7353eb70: Gateway · ULT aligns to the gateway text you can read. Its words already carry the link to the original language. Original · Greek aligns straight to the Greek words. See Align to the gateway text or the original language.
7fe4b76804a6: Suggest links is off at first. Turn it on to get links proposed from the verses you have already aligned. See Alignment suggestions.
50f0d72fb224: Above the word bank, a count shows how many of the verse's words are placed.
e1bb27c319b7: How alignment works opens a short explanation.
e01ac24b75fc: Note: Align is for Bible books. Story projects have no Align card.
bb519f9da8e1: If a book came from a USFM file that already had alignments, its aligned verses open in Align with the notice This verse already holds an alignment. You can't change those verses in Align yet. tC4 keeps their alignment as it was imported and writes it unchanged into the aligned USFM export.
b70cc1d616d4: The source cards always follow the original-language text your project uses. If a stored link points to a word that text doesn't have, the link is removed, its words go back to the word bank, and the verse is flagged for review.
4298e3a1f848: A verse in Align from a book that was added from an aligned USFM file. The notice says This verse already holds an alignment. Titus was added from a file that already holds alignments. tC4 keeps this verse's alignment as it is. You cannot change it in tC4 yet.
